minutes.headline: Conservation Commission meeting postponed a week for lack of a quorum and Zoom problems; no hearings held.
minutes.summary: Technical trouble with the Zoom link and host account kept members from joining, and a quorum was never reached. The vice chairman said no hearings would open and the meeting would be reposted for the following Wednesday at seven. A resident read a statement criticising the commission's handling of her garage permit and the agent.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission meeting was postponed because a quorum was never reached, and no hearings were opened.
Problems with the Zoom link and host account kept members from joining the meeting.
The meeting and its hearings were rescheduled for the following Wednesday at seven o'clock on Zoom, with the same agenda reposted.
A resident read a statement on her garage building permit and the commission's handling of it; no action was taken on it.

why_it_matters: Anyone with a project on this agenda, such as a wetlands filing, now waits a week for a hearing, and the delay can push back permit timelines.
The meeting failed on a technical point, not a vote, so nothing was decided and the same agenda returns for the rescheduled session.
watch_next: The rescheduled Conservation Commission meeting and hearings, the following Wednesday at seven o'clock via Zoom, on the same reposted agenda.
